title: classroom50/tests/v1
description: Machine-readable schema for the per-assignment tests.json materialized by materialize_tests.py (cli/gh-teacher/skeleton/dotgithub/scripts/) from each assignment's `tests` block and graded by runner.py's built-in interpreter. The `tests` array items are IDENTICAL to assignments-v1.schema.json #/$defs/test (the materializer copies them verbatim), so the two MUST stay in lockstep — the parity test asserts it. Same two inexpressible rules as the assignments schema: test names UNIQUE within the file, and name length capped at 100 BYTES (UTF-8), enforced in code (tests.go / runner.py).

defaults.description: Assignment-level defaults for the per-test reporting options, copied verbatim from the assignment's `test_defaults` by materialize_tests.py. A test's own `failure-details` / `show-output` value overrides the default. Absent means the built-in defaults (failure-details `full`, show-output `false`).

name.description: Unique within the assignment (enforce client-side); <= 100 UTF-8 bytes; no control characters.

timeout.description: Seconds, 1-600. 0 (or omitted) means the default of 10s.

points.description: Defaults to 0 (informational test) when omitted; the CLI always writes it.

failure-details.description: How much failure detail students see for this test (release body, Actions log, run summary). `full` (the default when absent) = unified diff for exact comparisons, otherwise expected+actual blocks, plus stderr. `actual-only` = the student's own stdout/stderr only — no expected output and no diff (a diff would reveal it). `none` = only the failure kind (wrong output, wrong exit code, timeout, setup failed). Overrides the assignment's `test_defaults`.

show-output.description: Include the captured stdout/stderr of this test's setup/run commands in the submission report and Actions log even when the test PASSES, inside a collapsed details block. Overrides the assignment's `test_defaults`. On the wire it is collapsed: writers omit the field when false, so readers must treat an absent field as `false` (passing output discarded).
